comment: Sixteen parameters holding each pattern's active flag and repeat count are declared with no widget (chance.cpp:220), because they are edited on the display instead; the gate length and glide parameters have no widget either and are reached from the menu. The maker's manual still describes a HOLD control that spans two to four clocks, but the code has replaced it with the even-note rests knob: chance.cpp:440 fixes every step's duration at one and its comment reads "Hold removed (replaced by Even rests)". The manual is out of date on that one control.
